title: Sky Color Changer
description: Allows you to change the fog and sky color with a simple command!
body:
# Main Description

**This mod allows you to simply change the color of the sky and the color of the fog to any color you want!**

This mod is designed to be easy to use, it all works with just one simple command!

# Command examples

**/skycol red**
```
changes the sky color to red (255,0,0)

```
**/skycol fog green**
```
changes the fog color to green (0,255,0)

```
**/skycol rgb 100 50 200**
```
changes the sky color to rgb values 100,50,200 (lavender)

```
**/skycol reset**
```
resets the sky color to default vanilla color
```


# Shader support

The mod doesn't have official shader support but it does have a best effort solution for iris that works with some shaders.

For example, complementary shaders supports the mod, BSL shaders doesn't.

If shaders are used, changing the fog color doesn't do anything. (at least with complementary)


# Quick note

I am aware that there are mods that do similar things.
However, I haven't found a mod that does this on the latest Fabric versions (only Forge 26.1.2 or Fabric 1.21.11).
This mod is specifically designed to be simple to use and to work on the latest Fabric versions (like 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2).
I will most likely update the mod when a new Minecraft version is released.
